title: Vermont Statutes Annotated, Title 9 (Commerce and Trade), Chapter 137 - Residential Rental Agreements
verified_how: fetched https://legislature.vermont.gov/statutes/chapter/09/137 (HTTP 200): headings 'Title 9 : Commerce and Trade' and 'Chapter 137 : Residential Rental Agreements', subchapter headings 'Subchapter 001 : GENERAL' and 'Subchapter 002 : RESIDENTIAL RENTAL AGREEMENTS' listing s 4451 (Definitions), 4452 (Exclusions), 4453 (Obligations implied), 4454 (Attempt to circumvent) and 4455 (Tenant obligations; payment of rent) onward; the Title 9 index gives 'Chapter 137 : Residential Rental Agreements - Contains: ss 4451 - 4475'. Every page of the Vermont Statutes Online carries the currency line 'The Statutes below include the actions of the 2025 session of the General Assembly.' and the caveat 'NOTE: The Vermont Statutes Online is an unofficial copy of the Vermont Statutes Annotated that is provided as a convenience.' No repeal marker appears on the cited provisions; repealed sections elsewhere in the same chapters are explicitly flagged 'Repealed. <act cite>', so the absence of that marker is meaningful.
notes: General consumer protection is the separate 9 V.S.A. ch. 63 (Consumer Protection, ss 2451-2494z), also seen on the Title 9 index; only one statute may be listed per topic, so the tenancy statute is listed here as the narrower and more everyday one.
